name: Primula Graybolt
original_name: プリムラ・グレイボルト
source:
The daughter of Marquis Graybolt.

She's giving her all to improving the status of women in the aristocracy.

I guess she's at least got that much in common with [url=/c156154]Lady Scarlet[/url].
